mapper.insert:
SELECT seq_job_profile.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO JOBPROFILE ( PROFILEIDX, USERIDX, PHOTOURL, NAME, TEL, EMAIL, GENDER, BIRTH, INTRODUCTION, STRENGTHS, ADDITIONALINFO, PROFILESTATUS, PROFILETITLE, ISDEFAULT, ISPUBLIC, CREATEDDATE, UPDATEDDATE ) VALUES ( #{profileIdx}, #{userIdx}, #{photoUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{userName}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{gender, jdbcType=CHAR}, TO_DATE(#{birth, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), #{introduce, jdbcType=CLOB}, #{strengths, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{additionalInfo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 1, #{title}, 'N', 'Y', SYSDATE, SYSDATE )
mapper.select: SELECT PROFILEIDX, USERIDX, PHOTOURL, NAME, TEL, EMAIL, GENDER, TO_CHAR(BIRTH, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BIRTH, INTRODUCTION, STRENGTHS, ADDITIONALINFO, PROFILESTATUS, PROFILETITLE, ISDEFAULT, ISPUBLIC, TO_CHAR(CREATEDDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATEDDATE, TO_CHAR(UPDATEDDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS UPDATEDDATE FROM JOBPROFILE WHERE USERIDX = #{userIdx} ORDER BY CREATEDDATE DESC

SELECT PROFILEIDX, USERIDX, PHOTOURL, NAME, TEL, EMAIL, GENDER, TO_CHAR(BIRTH, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS BIRTH, INTRODUCTION, STRENGTHS, ADDITIONALINFO, PROFILESTATUS, PROFILETITLE, ISDEFAULT, ISPUBLIC, TO_CHAR(CREATEDDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS CREATEDDATE, TO_CHAR(UPDATEDDATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS UPDATEDDATE FROM JOBPROFILE WHERE PROFILEIDX = #{profileIdx}
mapper.update: UPDATE JOBPROFILE SET PROFILETITLE = #{title}, INTRODUCTION = #{introduce, jdbcType=CLOB}, TEL = #{phone}, EMAIL = #{email}, GENDER = #{gender, jdbcType=CHAR}, BIRTH = TO_DATE(#{birth, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'YYYY-MM-DD'), STRENGTHS = #{strengths, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ADDITIONALINFO= #{additionalInfo, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, PHOTOURL = #{photoUrl, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATEDDATE = SYSDATE WHERE PROFILEIDX = #{profileIdx}
